title: Notice of Change in Procedural Schedule

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                                        DOCKET NO. R—37905


                  LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION, EX PARTE.


In   re:   Notice of proceeding regarding determination and evaluation         of private use electrical
networks in order to enable generation to serve new large loads looking to locate in Louisiana.

                                 NOTICE OF SCHEDULE CHANGE


           On June 18, 2026, Louisiana Public Service Commission (“LPSC” or “Commission”) Staff


ﬁled its Notice of Procedural Schedule and First Request for Information (“Notice”). In its Notice,


Staff provided a procedural schedule with a Final Rule being issued on October 30, 2026 for


consideration by the Commission at the November 2026 Business and Executive Session.


           Due to the extensive nature of the topics to be covered by Staff, the robust participation by


stakeholders, and the importance of potential policy implications arising out of this docket, Staff

needs additional time to complete its analysis.     As such, Staff is providing notice to stakeholders


that a Final Rule is anticipated to be ﬁled on November 4, 2026, which will remain timely for


Commission consideration at the November 2026 Business and Executive Session.


                                                         Respectfully submitted,
